meta.revisionPolicy: Survey estimates are final on release. Each round is a cross-section; the two rounds are comparable by design but are never averaged or chained.
meta.coverage: All India, rural/urban; average MPCE by household employment type, ₹, without imputation
meta.note: Rural types are published with an agriculture/non-agriculture split; urban types are published aggregated (self-employed, regular wage/salaried, casual labour, others). The "All" type is omitted (it equals the All-India MPCE in hces-mpce). "Without imputation" is the headline MPCE convention (comparable across the two rounds); "with imputation" adds the imputed value of items received free of cost through social welfare programmes. Only the 2022-23 and 2023-24 HCES rounds exist in the eSankhyiki API — the 2011-12 and earlier NSS CES rounds are not served and are methodologically different; these series must never be spliced with them.
